description:
List the 241 RF and electronics calculators on rftools.io, or those in one category.
Inputs: category, optional: one of rf, pcb, power, signal, antenna, general, motor, protocol, emc, thermal, sensor, unit-conversion, audio. An unknown category is refused with this list.
Example: {"category":"pcb"}
Returns: A JSON array with each calculator's slug, title, category and description. search_calculators finds one by words instead of listing all 241.

category.description: Calculator category to filter by: rf, pcb, power, signal, antenna, general, motor, protocol, emc, thermal, sensor, unit-conversion, audio

name: list_calculators
title: List Calculators
